-10% |- |} |-| * These items can also be upgraded at the [[Forge of Potential]] with a [[Black Metal Protection Idol]]. == Notes == * No part of the armor protects the player from [[Freezing]], making it unsuitable for the [[Mountain]] biome. ** This can be remedied by swapping the Linen cape for a [[Lox Cape]] or [[Wolf cape]]. == Trivia == * Historically, it is yet to be confirmed whether Vikings wore padded armor. Assuming that they did, padded armor plausibly provided comfort as much as protection, more so if worn underneath mail armor (though it provided decent protection, mail armor did little to absorb or dissipate the force of a blow, resulting in bruises at best and broken bones at worst). == Gallery == File:ArmorPadded.png|A complete Padded Armor set. {{Armor}} [[Category:Armor]] [[cs:Prošívaná zbroj]] [[ru:Обитая броня]]
